additional_projects.name: MirageMesh
additional_projects.title: A local security workflow, from sensor to incident.
additional_projects.summary: A local-first security application with a supervised Go engine, isolated decoys, durable offline event spooling and a browser interface for incident replay and triage.
additional_projects.scope: The reference workflow is verified on Ubuntu 24.04 Linux amd64. Other hosts require their own workflow evidence; the complete OSS v1 gate is pending.

additional_projects.name: KeyHelix
additional_projects.summary: Offline-first secrets and authorization workspace with scoped access, audited reveals and key rotation. The published release targets Linux x86_64.
additional_projects.scope: Requires local Keycloak, OpenBao and rootless Podman services; it is not a hosted SaaS.
additional_projects.title: Protect secret material with scoped access and auditable rotation.

additional_projects.name: BreachAtlas
additional_projects.status: Local DFIR workspace · independent offline verifier
additional_projects.summary: Seals evidence with SHA-256, records custody, builds timelines and exports portable bundles for independent offline verification.
additional_projects.scope: Uses a local Go engine and separate verifier; run the documented synthetic workflow for evidence.
additional_projects.title: Preserve incident evidence and verify a portable bundle offline.

additional_projects.name: Demian
additional_projects.status: Seven single-player games · production acceptance pending
additional_projects.summary: A café-themed 2D game suite with asynchronous weekly competition and a Laravel backend. Mobile, hosting and character-art acceptance remain separate gates.
additional_projects.scope: A passing repository CI run is not proof of production backend, live coupons or final sprite acceptance.
additional_projects.title: Build mobile-first café games with server-authoritative competition.

career.positioning: Backend & Full-Stack Software Engineering · Application Security
